//: SCRUM-1011: used only by eslint.preflight.config.mjs (never by `pnpm typecheck` or CI).
The root tsconfig includes *.ts/*.tsx only, so plain JavaScript has no type information and the typed Sonar rules
(S2871, S3403, S4043, S6594, S5852, S6759) would stay silent on every .mjs/.js file. This project gives the linter types for them.
